Md Munsurul Hoque Chowdhury, Advocate— For the Petitioner. 
Abdur Razak Khan with Md Nesar Ahmed, Advocate—For the Opposite Parties. 
Syed Haider Ali, Deputy Attorney-General — For the State.
parties:
Nazir Hossain (Md) ------ Petitioner
vs
Zubaed Md Adel and others ------ Opposite Parties
full_judgment:
8. Let us consider the depositions of the witnesses. PW 1, Md Nazir Hossain is the informant, brother of the deceased and an eye-witness, in his deposition stated that he along with deceased and Arman, Joney, Ali Hossain Babul and other 3/4 persons were gossiping in front of Nira Nipa Pharmacy, situated at 1, Nur Boksh lane. At that moment, due to previous rivalry, Jubaed Adel, Tarique Adel, Pappu, Nittay Sarker, Jahangir Adel with 4/5 others, came out from the residence of Jahangir Adel, at No. 29, Abul Khairat Road, that is, from eastern side and on the leadership of Jubaed Adel, the aggressors came near to the deceased, Kamal, Jubaed Adel ordered to catch Kamal and shoot him and on saying so, Jubaed Adel shot at Kamal from his pistol, Tareq Adel also shot from his pistol and accused Pappu, Nittay and other accuseds from different types of firearms, shot at deceased Kamal. The shots of Jubaed and Tareque Adel struck at the abdomen of the deceased, who fell down on the ground. The gunshots of other accused persons also struck the deceased at different parts of the body. This witness further stated that after Kamal fell down on the ground, accused persons tried to attack the informant and others, as a result, they fled away from the place of occurrence. This witness further stated that he was about 8 yards from the place of occurrence when Jahangir Mohammed Adel shouted "go go". This witness further stated that he along with Arman, Joney, Babul took the deceased to Dhaka Clinic, where the doctor declared Kamal dead. In cross-examination, this witness stated that he did not know where was the Office of Bangladesh Manobaudhikar Bastabayan Shongstha, nor he knows the executives of the Shangstha, he knew that at Malibag there is office of the Shangstha. This witness further stated that Nur Boksh lane extended north and south up to Nira Nipa Pharmacy and his residence is at 2/1, Nur Boksh lane. This witness further stated that just 100/200 yards from the place of occurrence, there is a police box. This witness further stated that just 50 yards from Nira Nipa Pharmacy, the point of Becharam Deory started. This witness further stated that to the west of his house, is tailoring shop of Anisur Rahman and on the opposite side of Nira Nipa Pharmacy, the office of Sohel Travel and also godown of Sohel Travel and there is a five-storied building of 'Telwala' and another one storied building near to the 5-storied building. This witness stated that there was always hangama in Usha Krirachakra, which is near to Becharam Deory and is crowded with trucks and pushcarts. This witness further stated that after receiving gunshot, Kamal was lying on the place of occurrence and from there, he was taken to Dhaka Clinic by informant, Arman, and Babul; from Dhaka Clinic, deceased was taken to Mitford Hospital and surathal report was prepared there. Daroga Safayet Hossain prepared surathal report but he did not see from where 'Daroga sahib' came to Mitford Hospital. This witness denied the suggestion that this surathal report is carbon copy and signature appeared therein is also in carbon copy. This witness stated that time "00.45" was written by over writing but later on stated that its like over-writing. This witness further stated that the original surathal report was not shown to him but this surathal report was shown. At the time of preparing surathal report daroga asked him several questions and whether the name of Jahangir Mohammed Adel was mentioned or not, he cannot recollect. He was in the police station for one hour. He denied the suggestion that Exhibit 1 (first information report) was replaced. This witness further stated that he pointed to the police the place of occurrence, police prepared sketch map on the night of occurrence; Akhter Hossain whether salesman of Nira Nipa Pharmacy, or whether the body of the deceased was flooded with blood, he could not recollect. He further stated that his body was blood stained but his wearing apparels were not seized by the Investigating Officer. This witness further stated that Kamal was not candidate for the Managing Committee of Mahutuly Government Primary School and he denied the suggestion that there was no dispute in between Jubaed Adel and others, over forming of Managing Committee of the School. This witness further stated that Jubaed Adel asked the deceased to help him for the election of the Managing Committee and if he denied, then he will face difficulty. This witness further stated that on 14-8-2001, in the house of Jahangir Md Adel, Pakistan flag was hoisted on the National Day of Pakistan, to which the informant raised objection and there was exchange of hot words. This witness stated that there are 3/4 mosques in and around the place of occurrence but he could not remember whether anyone from the mosque came to the place of occurrence. This witness stated that deceased Kamal was a producer of Film Industry and also a businessman of hide and skin and was a losing businessman. Kamal used to give money for film making and he did not know that there was any dispute over accounting of such money. He denied the suggestion that there were several creditors and they demanded their money from the deceased. He denied the suggestion that his brother used to take money/loan for his business and there was several cases for his misdeeds. This witness further stated that there was a 'kangali bhoge' at Nira Nipa Pharmacy on the night of occurrence and after taking meal, he did not know where Kamal went. The 'kangali bhoge' started from 3-00/4-00 PM and about 1500 people took their meal. He denied the suggestion that there was quarrel in between deceased, the brother of the informant, along with others over realisation of money for the 'kangali bhoge'. He did not see that, after the occurrence, anyone from Becharam Deory came to the place of occurrence, because he was at hospital. (But later on, this witness stated that, he could not remember). This witness stated that he did not know whether police awakened Jubaed Adel from sleep. He denied the suggestion that Pappu is an employee of Adel. He also did not know that Pappu was in sleep when police went to his residence. This witness further stated that he did not know whether there is a case pending over the title of his residence. He also denied the suggestion that Title Suit No. 196 of 1997 was pending at the time of occurrence. 

 16. This witness, on cross-examination, by Zubaed and Pappu, disclosed that in and around the place of occurrence, there are many shops and residential buildings. This witness stated that Nazir faced towards south and Kamal faced towards east. This witness and others were 5/6 yards from the assailants. Excepting Kamal, no one received any gunshot injury. This witness did not remember when Kamal was taken to hospital and whether there was any anti-party at the place of occurrence. Doctor of the clinic declared Kamal dead. This witness did not take any paper from the clinic nor he deposited any paper to that effect to the police. He signed Exhibit 2 which is carbon copy. From the place of occurrence, police seized an empty cartridge of gun. He denied the suggestion that Exhibit 3 was written by different ink. 

 39. PW 19, Md Moslem Ali, Inspector of Police, submitted report as per direction of Investigating Officer, SI, Shafaet Hossain. In the report, at item No. 5, there is mention of a cartridge of 12 bore rifle. This witness denied the suggestion that by this 12 bore rifle, seized cartridge cannot be fired. The colours of cartridge under item Nos. 8 and 5 are different. This witness further stated that seized cartridge is pellet. 

 45. It appears to us that PWs 1, 2, 3 and 4 themselves claimed to be the eye-witnesses of the occurrence. In their depositions, they stated that they saw Zubaed Adel and others came to the place of occurrence and called the deceased Kamal, and thereafter, there was indiscriminate firing. It is very much astonishing to us that in that indiscriminate firing, these four witnesses, who were in close proximity with the deceased and gossiping with deceased Kamal, but none of them received or sustained any injury. It also strikes our mind that when such type of indiscriminate firing then it is taken to be true that there must be huge or high sound which can be heard from a far place and when in around the place of occurrence there are numerous shops and residences together, mosque and also women's Madrasha as claimed by PWs, but none from these structures rushed to the place of occurrence. It is an admitted fact that night of 15th August, 2000 is an important night for the Awami League activists and deceased Kamal was an Awami League local leader holding a valuable post in local office of the said party, as such, it is reasonably presumed that some other men of the deceased party must be around the place of occurrence but we find no one came to rescue the deceased. It is very hard to believe that on such night deceased was killed by the persons who admittedly did not believe in the existence of Bangladesh. It also strikes our mind that, as it appears from the depositions of PWs 1 to 4 that after receiving gunshot injury, deceased Kamal fell down in front of Nira Nipa Pharmacy but from the deposition of PW 20, the investigating officer, we find that people gathered at Becharam Deory, which is more than 40 yards off from the place of occurrence and he went to Mitford Hospital after leaving two of his colleagues at the place of occurrence i.e. at Becharam Deory, not in front of Nira Nipa Pharmacy at Nur Boksh lane. We also find that accused persons were coming in a body and there is no evidence that after opening fire they fled from the place of occurrence as it appears from the deposition of PWs 1 to 4 but from the suggestions to the witnesses, it appears that accused persons were arrested when they were in sleep at their residence. If we believe the depositions of PWs 1 to 4 then we find the arms used at the place of occurrence are pistol or revolver, not gun, as gun is different from pistol and revolver, but it appears that gun was seized and also that cartridge which was sent to ballistic expert, it appears, it contains pellets which was sent for examination. From the deposition of doctor, we find that from the body of the deceased pellets were recovered and pellets are used in gun, not in pistol and revolver. Pistol or revolver's ammunition are of bullet type or some other type i.e. single metal object not pellet type. It also stuck our mind, that star witness, Mintu was neither mentioned in the first information report nor the witnesses disclosed about Mintu and also from the deposition of PW 20 it appears that Mintu disclosed everything which he knew, long after 25 days from the date of occurrence. It appears that PWs 7-11 who are also eye-witnesses and helped carry the dead body of the deceased to the clinic, but these witnesses gave totally different version as of the deposition of PWs 1-4. If this version be believed, then the place of, manner of and presence of accused opposite parties, are not only doubtful but impossible. PWs 7, 8 and 15 they have stated that the place of occurrence was at Becharam Deory. PW 15 himself sustained gunshot injury at that place. PW 20 stated that he received wireless information to that effect that an unidentified man was found lying at Becharam Deory. When eye-witnesses contradict as to manner, place and time of occurrence then a clear case of benefit of doubt is well established on the prosecution case whereupon no conviction can be awarded.
